sources.name: Gujarat TPVD — Ahmedabad final planning plots
sources.scope: Published final town-planning plots in Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation schemes only. The native search reference combines the provider's village, town-planning scheme and final-plot labels; fp_no is the display number. Bounded central Ahmedabad samples are verified; citywide completeness, current legal registration and ownership are not established.
sources.attribution: Government of Gujarat, Town Planning and Valuation Department (TPVD) — final AMC planning plots. Partial coverage; registration and currentness unverified. Adapted to WGS84.
sources.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational. No named reuse licence was identified on the inspected public map.
caveats: The official TPVD website links to the public TPWebGIS host; no account is used.
Final planning plots are not proof of current land title or ownership. Draft, preliminary and non-AMC schemes are excluded by fixed upstream and response-validated filters.
The server omits its certificate intermediate. A source-scoped published Sectigo intermediate completes the trusted chain; hostname and certificate validation remain enabled.
WFS FIDs and gid are transport data, not parcel identities.
The legacy WFS misreports the total on a final partial offset page. Queries request up to 1000 records and reject match counts above 1000; no offset-counter relaxation is applied.
